rca of the issue: The user-reported '401 background operation failed' toast was a frontend-only UX issue caused by axios (or fetch wrapper) surfacing background /auth/me and /sync/batch 401 responses to the user when no token was present. Backend behavior is correct: both endpoints correctly return 401 when auth is missing. Fix per main agent: (a) frontend api.js response interceptor swallows 401 silently and emits 'asys-auth-lost' event, (b) AuthContext only calls /auth/me if hasToken(), (c) Layout.jsx syncQueue only runs when hasToken(). Verified via tests 04/05 (401 shape correct) and 30/31 (sync/batch 401 without auth, 200 with auth). No backend regression; all previously-working endpoints still work; no data loss.
